emma_sec: FYI CI bumped a SAST critical on main and blocked deploy. weirdly no KMS decrypt audit for the deploy-sa around the same time. can someone sanity-check logs? :clipboard:
prashant_eng: saw the failed job. GH Actions shows decrypt error then a retry and success ~20s later. logs:```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z ERROR decrypt: permission denied
2026-03-20T14:02:31Z INFO retrying decrypt
2026-03-20T14:02:33Z INFO decrypt ok
```
mike_sre: likely propagation/timing with ephemeral grants. what was TTL for the short-lived grant created by keystore-service? if TTL < propagation time audit might not capture creation before first decrypt attempt.
prashant_eng: current grant TTL is 45s. we set it low to limit blast radius.
lisa_prodsec: two concerns: (A) premerge gate is useless if we can't trace decrypts in audit logs for blocked runs, (B) security needs a deterministic audit trail to approve exceptions. proposal: add premerge check that queries audit logs for a Decrypt protoPayload event tied to the service account that ran the job. If missing, mark PR needing security approval.
emma_sec: +1. drafting a lightweight GH Action that runs at the end of the deploy matrix and does:```bash
# look for KMS decrypt entry in Cloud Logging within last 5m for the service account
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.crypto.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="deploy-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"' --limit=1 --project=redwood-prod --format=json || exit 1
```
prashant_eng: a few notes: (1) make the action tolerant to eventual consistency by allowing a 30s buffer after job end before query, (2) bump TTL to 5m for deploy grants, (3) add exponential backoff on decrypt retries.
mike_sre: SGTM. I'll add a structured trace event emitted by the deploy job right before calling gcloud kms decrypt so we can correlate traceId => audit log. e.g. echo JSON with trace_id: $TRACE_ID to stdout and via Stackdriver structured logging.
cicd-bot: [auto] created ticket SEC-621: "premerge audit-check: ensure KMS decrypt present for SAST-critical blocking runs" assigned to @emma_sec. Link: https://github.internal/redwood/security/tickets/SEC-621
lisa_prodsec: also request infra: grant roles/cloudkms.decrypt (or the minimal cryptoKeyDecrypter role) to ci-audit-reader for reading audit entries, and increase Cloud Logging retention to 90d for compliance.
emma_sec: I'll file infra request and open the GH Actions PR. checklist in SEC-621: add action, TTL bump, retry logic, runbook update for oncall. I'll ping SRE for help with the trace shim.
prashant_eng: small opt: instead of failing PR immediately, the action should set a GitHub status "kms-audit": pending -> success/failure and if failure attach gcloud logging read output to the check and require manual approve. reduces noisy author pain.
mike_sre: I'll help implement the action + structured logging. also recommend a short-lived internal metric for missing-audit occurrences so we can track noise after rollout.
emma_sec: great. I'll update SEC-621 and follow up with PR link. Thanks all. :v:
